slogan: Chinese virtual singer ranking · archive & statistics platform
aboutBody: An open-source implementation of the Chinese Virtual Singer Ranking, modeled on vocabili.top, continuously collecting and aggregating Chinese virtual-singer songs from Bilibili's VOCALOID·UTAU partition.
Boards are published on daily, weekly, monthly and annual cycles, all bounded at 01:00 on the start day. Scores use an increment-based baseline and the official formula with corrections A/B/C/D.
All data comes from public Bilibili endpoints and is for study and archival purposes only; copyright belongs to the original authors and the platform. Contributions are welcome.

rules.name: Scope
items: Only songs whose title or description names both the synthesizer and the virtual singer.
Only videos whose actual musical content is at least 120 seconds long.
Songs whose audio or lyrics are produced by generative models are excluded.
Only publicly viewable, non-replaced videos (charged, hidden or heavily replaced videos are excluded).
Virtual-singer videos outside the VOCALOID·UTAU partition are only backfilled from the original-music partition when traceable.

rules.name: Virtual singer definition
items: Works without singing-synthesis technology are excluded; voice-changing / voice-mixing is treated as a human voice.
No prominent human vocal may take the lead role.
The voicebank must clearly represent a non-human character, with no homogeneous tie to a real person's public persona.
An official voicebank enters scope after its first demo song; fan-made voicebanks enter scope after public distribution.
Iterations, engine changes or visual redesigns count as the same virtual singer series.
Voicebanks that are unavailable publicly or under IP dispute are generally excluded.

rules.name: Exclusions
items: Not a complete song: medleys, a cappella, clearly untuned, meaningless lyrics, heavy distortion or clipping.
Missing credits: no work or author information in the text area, reposts without source or author.
Controversial content: heavily reused parameters, generative-model participation, disputed voicebanks.
Off-topic elements: personal attacks, political or historical commentary, altered lyrics.
Direct translations of foreign songs, non-clean audio from offline debuts, ads as the main content.

rules.name: Repeat submissions
items: Only one entry per annual settlement cycle.
A remade version may be collected again after the original has been collected for a full annual cycle.
Videos with the same production staff are treated as being by the same author.
Mark planned full versions, PV versions or reworks as [not final] on upload.

rules.name: Grey-release additions
items: Tags must include one of: VOCALOID, Synthesizer V, ACE Studio, UTAU, DiffSinger, X Studio, DeepVocal, SharpKey, VoiSona; or the Chinese virtual singer song tag; or a top-10 vocalist from the latest weekly board.
The submission must be posted in the Music partition.

formulaDesc: All collected submissions in range are scored as follows and ranked from highest to lowest.

formula.name: Base formula
items: Final score = view score + interaction score + favorite score + coin score + like score

formula.name: Component scores
items: View score = base view score × correction D. If views > 10000, base = views × 0.5 + 5000; otherwise base = views.
Interaction score = (comments + danmaku) × correction A × 15.
Favorite score = favorites × correction B.
Coin score = coins × correction C.
Like score: if likes > coins × 2, use coins × 2; otherwise use likes.

formula.name: Corrections
items: Correction A (no cap) = ((base view score + favorites) ÷ (base view score + favorites + (danmaku + comments) × 20))².
Correction B (max 50): if favorites > coins × 2, (coins² ÷ (views × favorites)) × 1000; otherwise (favorites ÷ views) × 250.
Correction C (max 50): if coins > favorites, (favorites² ÷ (views × coins)) × 250; otherwise (coins ÷ views) × 250.
Correction D (max 1): if favorites > coins, (coins ÷ views) × 25; otherwise (favorites ÷ views) × 25.

formula.name: Other notes
items: Only on-platform data is counted.
Corrections keep two decimal places.
Boards are increment-based: the daily snapshot from the day before the period starts is the baseline.
Daily, weekly, monthly and annual cycles are all bounded at 01:00 on the start day.

items.name: SUPERHIT (SH)
items.desc: Reach: top 3 on the main board twice in total

items.name: Annual #1
items.desc: Reach: become the annual board's #1 for the first time

items.name: Monban
items.desc: Reach: on the main board 20 of 28 issues, or 30 of 50, without 8 consecutive misses

items.name: Myth
items.desc: Reach: total views exceed ten million

items.name: Permanent display
items.desc: Once earned, the badge shows on every later issue.

items.name: Full history
items.desc: Judged against the complete board history, not just the current year.

items.name: Increment based
items.desc: Ranks and achievements use the net increment inside the period, not cumulative values.
